{{Top|leg}}
'''Lonsigar''' was a commodity. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a supply of lonsigar was abandoned in an asteroid field, and later recovered by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] task force led by the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] ''[[Stimsenj'kat]]''. A pair of [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruisers]] in service around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] were named ''[[Lonsigar 1]]'' and ''[[Lonsigar 2]]''.
